name: web-ppt-monorepo
description: 纯浏览器端 PPT 渲染引擎：.pptx / .ppt → 统一 Schema → SVG

scripts.build: npm run build -w @web-ppt/core && npm run build -w @web-ppt/edit-core && npm run build -w @web-ppt/viewer-core && npm run build -w @web-ppt/fonts
scripts.test: node tooling/test-core.mjs && node tooling/test-edit.mjs && node tooling/test-edit-equivalence.mjs && node tooling/test-metafile.mjs
scripts.fixtures: node tooling/make-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-edit-basic-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-zip-passthrough-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-ppt-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-showcase.mjs && node tooling/make-chart-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-effects-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-media-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-metafile-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-hidden-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-autofit-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-placeholder-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-ole-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-encrypted-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-math-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-smartart-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-ppt-encrypted-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-hardcases-fixture.mjs && node tooling/make-embedfont-fixture.mjs
scripts.build:site: npm run build && npm run build -w @web-ppt/site
